name: Shen
title: Eye of Twilight

passive.name: Ki Barrier

description.normalized: Gains a shield that absorbs 51 (+14% HP) damage for 2.5 seconds after completing an ability. If the ability affected at least one champion, Ki Barrier's cooldown is reduced by 4 seconds. Gains 10 Energy when Shen's abbilties damage an enemy.

passive.rawParsedText:
Gains a shield that absorbs 51 (+14% HP) damage for 2.5 seconds after completing an ability. If the ability affected at least one champion, Ki Barrier's cooldown is reduced by 4 seconds.

Gains 10 Energy when Shen's abbilties damage an enemy.

q.name: Twilight Assault

description.normalized: Recalls the Spirit Blade, enhancing his next 3 attacks to deal an additional 12 + 3% / 3.5% / 4% / 4.5% (+1.5% AP) of the target's max Health as magic damage. If the Spirit Blade passed through an enemy champion, the damage bonus is increased to 12 + 5.5% / 6% / 6.5% / 7% (+2% AP) of the target's max Health as magic damage and Shen gains 50% Attack Speed. Enemy champions the Spirit Blade passes through are slowed by 15% / 20% / 25% / 30% for 2 seconds while moving away from Shen. Deals 150% damage to minions.

Enemy champions the Spirit Blade passes through are slowed by 15% / 20% / 25% / 30% for 2 seconds while moving away from Shen.

Deals 150% damage to minions.

w.name: Spirit's Refuge

description.normalized: Sends the Spirit Blade to an allied champion, creatng a zone that blocks enemy attacks for 1.75 seconds.

w.rawParsedText: Sends the Spirit Blade to an allied champion, creatng a zone that blocks enemy attacks for 1.75 seconds.

e.name: Shadow Dash

description.normalized: Dashes forward, dealing 60 / 90 / 120 / 150 (+15% HP) physical damage to enemy champions and monsters, taunting them for 1.5 seconds.

e.rawParsedText: Dashes forward, dealing 60 / 90 / 120 / 150 (+15% HP) physical damage to enemy champions and monsters, taunting them for 1.5 seconds.

r.name: Stand United

description.normalized: Channels for 3 seconds, shielding an allied champion for 170 / 340 / 510 (+135% AP +15% HP) damage for 5 seconds, increased by 0% - 60% based on target's missing health. Upon completing the channel, Shen teleports to the target ally.

r.rawParsedText:

Upon completing the channel, Shen teleports to the target ally.
